project.name: Bottin Web Assets
project.description:
Browser code shared by the client and the admin dashboard: key handling and the NAP sign-in handshake. Both applications hold a Nostr key in the browser and prove control of it the same way, and a second copy of key encryption would drift — the copy that drifts silently being the one without tests.
Served from META-INF/resources, so the files keep the same /js/ URLs they had when they lived in the client, and no template changes.
